exact_prompt_lines: Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: original 2D identity-preserving same-hilt two-hand contact proof, candidate 01 of at most 04

Input images: Image 1 is the strongest rejected Round007 combat composition and is the base for the mature face, body proportions, neutral three-quarter ready stance, rendering, and already-readable same-hilt two-hand closure. Image 2 is the sole authority for exact Nyra Kestrel identity and engineering anchors. Image 3 is the sole authority for the exact Stormcage Odachi. Preserve Image 1's recognizable person, palette, painterly finish, and credible load-bearing hand anatomy, but correct every issue below using Images 2 and 3.

Primary request: Create exactly ONE full-body neutral-studio three-quarter ready stance of the exact Round007 Nyra holding exactly ONE complete Round007 Stormcage Odachi. This is a technical grip/contact proof, not an action scene.

Composition/framing: pale warm-gray studio background, subtle ground shadow only. Nyra stands slightly right of center facing viewer-left in restrained three-quarter view. Full head, yoke, both hands, both boots, complete blade tip and pommel all inside generous margins. Put the ENTIRE long hilt in open background to the viewer-left of her torso and legs, outside every body/leg silhouette, with a clear strip of negative space between hilt and clothing. Put the guard farther viewer-left, blade extending diagonally upward-left through empty background. The sword may not cross, pass behind, or intersect torso, belt, hips, thighs, greaves, boots, yoke, or hair. One sword only.

Exact two-hand contact, highest priority: BOTH complete hands must visibly close around two separated cobalt-wrapped regions of the SAME single continuous hilt. Character RIGHT/leading hand immediately below the ivory guard. Character LEFT/trailing hand immediately above the ivory pommel. Leave the ivory separator collar plus exposed blue grip clearly visible between hands. The same continuous blue-wrapped hilt must visibly enter one side and exit the other side of EACH closed hand. Each hand shows exactly one opposed thumb and four distinct curled fingers, with fingertip/cloth compression, contact pressure and small contact shadows. No hand on copper body conductor, belt, blade-base cage/module, guard edge, separator, pommel, or separate object. No hover, gap, clenched fist beside grip, fusion, extra/missing digit, hidden palm, crossed forearms, or broken wrist. Both wrists neutral and load-bearing in line with forearms.

Exact Nyra identity invariants: restore the exact large split warm-IVORY CERAMIC induction yoke visibly ATTACHED on its blackened-steel mount behind her character LEFT shoulder, with open gap and two blunt terminals fully visible and separated from head/hair. Restore the exact short asymmetric braided hair and mature lived-in face from Image 2. Preserve the exact protected oxidized-copper conductor diagonally from the yoke into the compact RIGHT-HIP ivory capacitor and continuing down to the dramatically heavy RIGHT grounding greave with blackened-steel slabs, copper shunts, extra-wide broad flat zero-heel sole. Preserve lighter LEFT cobalt gaiter and simple flat boot. Preserve cobalt underlayer, ivory ceramic, oxidized copper, and blackened steel macro blocks. No redesign, mirroring, added armor, or omitted anchor.

Exact weapon invariants: one gently curved blackened-steel odachi with one small pale mineral billet physically caged in a black rectangular frame ONLY at the blade base; broad low rectangular ivory ceramic guard; long oval deep-cobalt woven-insulated hilt with ivory ferrules, visible central separator collar, capped ivory pommel; recessed copper route only, never on gripping surfaces. Keep the accepted scale, curve, tip, guard, cage, hilt and pommel. No second weapon or scabbard.

Style/medium: match the supplied premium original 2D industrial-fantasy concept painting exactly: crisp controlled hand-painted edges, matte materials, restrained linework and wear, large readable ivory/cobalt/copper/steel blocks.

Hard reject if any invariant fails: missing or detached yoke; wrong/right greave ambiguity; broken conductor chain; identity/weapon redesign; either hand not enclosing the same blue hilt; any hand touching copper, body gear, guard, module or separate object; malformed digits; wrist kink; hilt/body overlap; sword/body intersection; crop; extra person/weapon.

Avoid: VFX, glow, lightning, text, logo, watermark, environment, cinematic action, generic dark armor, generic katana, long crystal channel, pin-up anatomy, bust sculpting, corset, heels, cape, skirt, civilian redesign, franchise cues, photoreal cosplay, 3D render.

rejection_reasons: The image creates two distinct weapon objects: one complete unheld sword floating at viewer-left and one detached short hilt-like object held by the character.
The two hands therefore do not contact the hilt of the one complete odachi, invalidating one-object continuity and the same-hilt proof.
